items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Perrenchio; the interviewer mentions him in the context of marketing differences and clothing styles.

ctx.x: Jerry [?Florencia].Perrenchio I remember reading something about a difference in marketing, that he wanted the slinky, sexy, low-cut, that you had a closet full of, if I have this right, Walter Bass matte jersey dresses with Dolman sleeves, in every color. First, the lighter side of this. Talk to us about your taste in clothes, then and now.

It’s pretty much the same. I just saw an ad in – when I was being honored, there was an ad with the Walter Bass – no, no, the content page of Ebony magazine has me, full page picture of Nancy Wilson in a Walter Bass. I bought it. I remember that I bought it at Sidney’s. Someone said, how could you remember something like that? But it was me in a Walter Bass matte jersey gown, and it’s a full page on the table of contents. That’s the background on the table of contents, is a picture of me in that gown. I’ve always…
